test_slice_constructors: test pybind11 slice constructors by creating forward and reversed slice objects with size_t and optional types
test_generalized_iterators: test generalized iterators on IntPairs to filter nonzero items, keys, and values from a list of pairs
test_sequence: test pybind11 Sequence class by creating sequences, setting items, reversing, and verifying constructor statistics
test_map_iterator: test StringMap iteration by creating a map, accessing items, and iterating over keys, values, and items
test_python_iterator_in_cpp: test Python iterator consumption in C++ by converting tuples, lists, and iterators to lists via C++ functions
